_comment: The stylesheets and app.js are cached for an hour and then revalidated.
Not 'immutable' with a year, which is the usual advice: these filenames
never change, so a forgotten cache bust would leave a returning visitor
running last week's payment code for a year. An hour is short enough to
be safe and long enough to spare the round trips while somebody reads
three pages in a row. The ?v= query on the tags is the manual override:
bump it in index.html and en/index.html when a change has to land now.
Without any of this the browser still revalidates and gets a 304, so the
saving here is round trips, not bytes.
